genericProblem: A contract generator or an ad-hoc preparation step materializes contract-relative directory names at the repository root, leaving empty look-alike roots outside the approved contracts/openapi ownership boundary.
finiteDenominator: both contract-relative top-level families emitted by the accepted edge materializer: components and paths
all source references to repository-root components/ or paths/
searchQueries: find repository root and depth-two empty directories
rg repository-root components and paths references outside contracts and documentation
rg mkdirSync, path.join and path.resolve calls involving components or paths
compare directory mtimes for same-run sibling creation
counterexamples: contracts/openapi/components and contracts/openapi/paths are the approved non-empty contract source roots and must remain.
tools/r3-frontend-boundaries and tools/r3-gates are unrelated historical empty directories with different ownership and are not deleted by this disposition.
OpenAPI internal references containing #/components are schema syntax, not filesystem references to repository-root components.

findings.problem: Repository-root components contains eight empty owner-like child directories, has no files or symlinks, and has no runtime/build/source reference.
findings.expected: Only contracts/openapi/components owns component source directories.

findings.problem: Repository-root paths contains three empty face-like child directories created in the same minute as root components and likewise has no files or references.
findings.expected: Only contracts/openapi/paths owns path source directories.

findings.problem: The existing code-layout control validates selected source and contract children but does not reject unapproved repository-root directories, so both sibling drifts are false green.
findings.expected: The existing code-layout control derives or declares the approved root families and rejects repository-root components and paths with a production red mutation.
